# TheMentR

> TheMentR is a next-generation education platform connecting 100% background-checked home tutors, motivated K-12 students, and parents with structured learning, diagnostic assessments, and full curriculum mapping.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://thementr.com/): Where Learning Meets Purpose — 100% verified home tutors and diagnostic assessments.
- [Pricing](https://thementr.com/pricing): Transparent home tuition packages across Classes 1–12, CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE & State Boards.
- [AVSAR Assessment](https://thementr.com/avsar): In-home 60–90 minute diagnostic assessment visits and student evaluation reports.
- [Ecosystem](https://thementr.com/ecosystem): Integrated Parent, Teacher, and Olympiad prep mobile applications.
- [Educational Journal](https://thementr.com/blogs): Expert study guidance, parenting tips, and K-12 learning insights.
- [Contact Us](https://thementr.com/contact): 24/7 customer support, toll-free helpline, and assessment booking inquiry.
- [HTML Sitemap](https://thementr.com/sitemap): Complete website directory and section navigation.

## Core Services

- **Home Tuition & 1-on-1 Mentorship**: AI-assisted tutor matching for K-12 students across CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE, and State Boards with verified educators.
- **AVSAR Diagnostic Assessment Visit**: Comprehensive at-home learning evaluations (60–90 min) measuring subject familiarity, learning style, and academic goals before tutor placement.

## Platform Information

- **Target Audience**: Students (Classes 1–12, KG–PG), Parents seeking home tuition, Verified Educators, and Educational Institutions.
- **Safety & Verification**: Multi-layered background screening, government ID authentication, degree verification, demo sessions, and annual re-verification.
- **Headquarters**: Plot no. 2937/6463, Saptasati Vihar, Palasuni, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751025, India.
- **Primary Contact Email**: contact@thementr.com
- **Toll-Free Helpline**: 1800 889 2388 (9:30 AM – 5:30 PM IST, All days)
- **Direct Phone**: +91 96685 62631 (24/7 Support)
